gloss: second volume; last volume (of a two- or three-part work)

definitions.explanation: The final volume of a book or work published in two or three parts. The pair of {上巻|じょうかん} (first volume).

examples.japanese: {下巻|げかん}はまだ{読|よ}んでいない。
examples.english: I haven't read the second volume yet.

examples.japanese: {下巻|げかん}の{発売|はつばい}を{楽|たの}しみにしている。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to the release of the second volume.

examples.japanese: {下巻|げかん}まで{読|よ}み{終|お}わったとき、{物語|ものがたり}の{全体|ぜんたい}がようやく{理解|りかい}できた。
examples.english: When I finished reading through the second volume, I finally understood the story as a whole.

notes:
Used for the second (or final) volume of a two- or three-part book set. The pair is {上巻|じょうかん} (first volume); in three-part sets, {中巻|ちゅうかん} sits between them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下巻|げかん}を{読|よ}む: read the second volume
- {下巻|げかん}を{買|か}う: buy the second volume
- {上巻|じょうかん}・{下巻|げかん}{セット}: first-and-second volume set

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上巻|じょうかん}: first volume — the pair of {下巻|げかん}
- {中巻|ちゅうかん}: middle volume — used only in three-part sets
- {最終巻|さいしゅうかん}: final volume — used for multi-volume series of any length
